product_metadata.title: Vela Lanterns Metal Moroccan Decorative LED Fairy Lights Candle Lantern Holders for Home Decor, Amber Glass, Large
features: Not just candlelight—these decorative candle lanterns add color, pattern and an exotic global vibe to your patio or porch.
Large size lantern with large 7" high glass panels with large door opening.
Matching colored LED fairy lights included. 50 LEDs, 16 feet long, uses 3 AA batteries (not included). No need to buy candles!
Suitable for hanging or use as a freestanding lamp. Great for Ramadan, holidays, weddings, funerals, parties, patio, corporate events for indoors/outdoors and more.
Measures: 5.5" x 4.8" x 12" tall, 13.75" tall with loop. Iron and glass. Many other colors available.
